The '''Ambush of Convoy LMC-55c''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] operation to capture a [[Lant Mining Corporation]] convoy. Alliance forces ambushed the convoy, which was under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] protection. After destroying the Imperial escort, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Riane]] of the Alliance demanded the surrender of the convoy. Captain [[Pricene]], commander of [[LMC Hauler One-Six]], eventually complied.
